purpose: Interactive Iraq branch map section visual concepts

concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished high-fidelity WEBSITE SECTION mockup for Super Sauce, an Arabic Iraqi restaurant brand. The new section is an interactive north-up MAP OF IRAQ with clickable restaurant branch pins; selecting one reveals branch details. This is a visual proposal, all pin positions and details are illustrative, not verified operating locations. Arabic right-to-left layout with accurate joined Arabic text, bold geometric Alexandria-like type. Existing palette: cream #faf7ef, restaurant red #ce1725, butter yellow #ffe044, dark ink #26221f, warm subtle borders #e1d9cd. Crisp legible UI and elegant information hierarchy, generous spacing, subtle rounded corners, simple line icons, no generic SaaS look. The Iraq outline MUST be geographically recognizable, upright north-up, approximate real proportions: broad western desert extending toward Jordan/Syria, narrower rugged northern frontier with Turkey, long northeastern/eastern boundary along Iran, southeast taper toward Basra and the small Gulf coastline. Do not substitute an arbitrary blob or another country. The map uses the subdued cream/paper palette with red branch markers, not random colorful province patches. Baghdad near the central-eastern part of Iraq, Babylon and Karbala south/southwest of Baghdad, Najaf farther south. Do not invent branches elsewhere. At national scale, the Baghdad cluster represents five example branches; there are separate sample pins around Babylon, Karbala and Najaf. An active branch marker must stand out with a yellow center or clear contrasting selected state. No shopping cart, checkout, favorite hearts, live open/closed status, fabricated ratings, distance claims or real phone numbers. Use placeholder phone "07XX XXX XXXX" in left-to-right direction. This is a flat straight-on website UI screenshot, no monitor/laptop/mockup perspective. No masthead, brand logo or page footer. Render only specified text, no random text. Place discreet footer caption "تصوّر توضيحي — مواقع وأرقام تجريبية" clearly to communicate the proposal.
Asset: landscape desktop homepage section, about 1536x1024. Concept A: branded country map with a FIXED SELECTED-BRANCH PANEL at the right. This is the recommended calm homepage design.
Top-right large headline "اعثر على أقرب فرع" with small text "اضغط على الخريطة وشوف تفاصيل الفرع." Below headline a horizontal row of fine-outline city filter buttons in RTL: "الكل" selected red, then "بغداد", "بابل", "كربلاء", "النجف". Upper-left a small outlined location button "استخدم موقعي".
Main content beneath: map occupies left 63%, details right 32%, enough cream gap between. The Iraq silhouette is a warm pale paper fill against the cream background, slightly darker fine boundary with subtle internal administrative boundaries, no texture, no 3D effects. Label the four relevant cities. Near Baghdad show a compact red cluster disk marked "5" and an offset selected pin/tag "حي الجامعة"; separate smaller pin locations near the three other cities. Compact + and minus zoom buttons at map lower-left. Quiet legend "اضغط للتكبير" near the Baghdad cluster. The map should feel interactive and spatial, not an infographic of statistics.
The selected details panel is white-cream with a thin warm border and no heavy shadow. It has a small realistic restaurant storefront photo with a red facade and warm light, not a food product. Below photo, bold title "فرع حي الجامعة", smaller "بغداد • الكرخ". Three clear rows with small line icons: location "حي الجامعة، شارع الحمداني", telephone "07XX XXX XXXX", clock "١٢ ظهراً – ٢ ليلاً". Service chips "صالة" "سفري" "توصيل". At bottom, prominent red button "افتح الاتجاهات" with direction icon; below it two compact outline buttons "اتصل بالفرع" and "واتساب". Selected panel perfectly readable and not over-packed. Thin red/cream checker seam along very bottom, one small red five-point star near the header. Whole section looks buildable with real HTML controls and interactive map.

Asset: landscape desktop homepage section, about 1536x1024. Concept B: large edge-to-edge map canvas with a BRANCH POPOVER ANCHORED TO THE SELECTED PIN. This design has NO permanent side panel, the map is the dominant full-width surface.
Cream header across top about 18% height: large Arabic heading at right "السوبر قريب منك." Supporting line "اختار أي فرع على الخريطة." At left, a white search field with search icon and placeholder "ابحث عن فرع أو منطقة". Beneath header, one very large lightly bordered rounded map taking nearly full remaining canvas width. The geographic view shows the entire recognizable Iraq outline at substantial scale, slightly to the right of center; subtle ghosted neighboring land visible but no competing labels. A few restrained city labels, thin pale blue Tigris/Euphrates paths in reasonable geography, extremely fine road lines; it must look like a real calm interactive map style. Include red pin clusters centered on the same illustrative four cities, a clustered Baghdad count "5", zoom controls + and minus at lower-left, a little compass in upper-left, and a bottom reset link "عرض العراق".
Near the selected Baghdad pin, a visually connected floating white branch popover is open over the LEFT portion of the map so the country silhouette remains identifiable. The popup has a small pointed anchor tail toward the selected marker. It contains top row title "فرع حي الجامعة" and small close X button, a slim landscape thumbnail of a red restaurant storefront, then a location row "بغداد، حي الجامعة", a secondary address line "شارع الحمداني", a phone row "07XX XXX XXXX", an hours row "١٢ ظهراً – ٢ ليلاً", and a small line "صالة • سفري • توصيل". Footer of popup is two clear buttons: red "الاتجاهات", cream outlined "اتصل". Small text action "واتساب" under the buttons. No duplicate detail panel. The pin selection creates a yellow-highlighted marker, with a subtle leader/tail making its relation to the popup unambiguous. The popover feels like a natural map interaction with restrained depth and a soft offset shadow. Label the overall design below, outside the map, "تصوّر توضيحي — مواقع وأرقام تجريبية".

Asset: landscape presentation approximately 1536x1024 showing TWO MOBILE RESPONSIVE WEBSITE SECTION STATES side by side, as large sharp flat rectangular viewport crops without phone hardware or tilted devices. Plain warm paper presentation background, roomy gap. A modest top title in dark ink exactly "الخريطة على الموبايل". Above the RIGHT screenshot state label "اختار الفرع"; above the LEFT screenshot state label "شوف التفاصيل". Each screenshot approximately 430px wide by 800px tall with comfortable readable Arabic UI, display at a scale that makes text legible.
RIGHT SCREENSHOT is the initial map state: cream top area with heading "اعثر على أقرب فرع"; small search box "ابحث عن فرع"; a compact horizontal city filter row "الكل" selected red, "بغداد", "بابل". Below is a large recognizable north-up Iraq silhouette map on cream, nearly full screen width, with red Baghdad cluster "5" and three red pins around Babylon, Karbala, Najaf, geographic labels. At bottom a white short instructional rail with location icon says "اضغط على أي فرع لعرض التفاصيل". Small map zoom controls, map fills viewport.
LEFT SCREENSHOT shows the selected state of the SAME mobile map. The map is visible in the upper 40%, with selected Baghdad pin in yellow/red and label "حي الجامعة". A cream/white rounded-top BOTTOM SHEET occupies the lower 60%; a short subtle drag handle at its top and close X in corner. The sheet has title "فرع حي الجامعة", subtitle "بغداد • الكرخ", a small wide storefront photograph about 100px high. Then three compact but readable icon/text rows: "حي الجامعة، شارع الحمداني"; "07XX XXX XXXX"; "١٢ ظهراً – ٢ ليلاً". Compact service tags "صالة" "سفري" "توصيل". At sheet bottom a full-width red button "افتح الاتجاهات", then two half-width outlined buttons "اتصل" and "واتساب". Every main touch target comfortably large, never tiny. Distinct sheet behavior implied by visible map above it and drag handle. Nothing covers main information or makes it unreadable. A small calm footer caption outside the two screens reads "تصوّر توضيحي — مواقع وأرقام تجريبية".
